summary: Autonomy-score audit: cache_read is correctly excluded and conservation holds, but (a) "productive" counts input+output, not output tokens (16.14M productive > 15.40M raw output — paper's "productive OUTPUT tokens" label is wrong), and (b) merged-sink credit is dominated by self-reported status==='done': 335 of 344 done tasks have NO git merge (only 9 git-verified), so ~97% of sinks are unverified; plus 16.8M of 17.7M tokens are unattributed session chat credited productive only via context edges into those self-reported sinks. 103.5x needs relabeling ("total tokens flowing to self-reported-complete work") or recomputation gated on git.merged; denominator (161k human tokens, chars/3.8) looks sane.

subject: Audit autonomy score implementation for inflation bugs
description: Read-only audit of lib/costflow.js, lib/human-input.js, and the daemon /cost-flow endpoint to verify the 103.5× autonomy and 92% productive figures aren't inflated by bugs (double counting, wrong denominator, merged-flag over-credit).
